chunks.text: I think it would be great if you could put together my top two choices. So low tech and science. So I know that kind of is contradictory because science revolves around technology, but I think that technology should be utilized only in the sense of progression versus not the daily consumer.

So if you don't work in a field of science or healthcare, you shouldn't have that unlimited access to technology. The day-to-day people should have low-tech. I think those combined together would be a great option.
